scope: Every ordinary landing action paired with its next same-player target before next top-level decision and distinct actual landing payment in display-turn order. Aomomo steps omit explicit resource delta: use immediate before/after energy only for a sole Aomomo choice followed directly by the next action and require agreement with executed cost label. Whole-entry snapshot cost may net an earlier trade and is not treated as gross landing cost. Candidate preview planet/index/rocket/cost must match execution. Direct-score arithmetic covered by real Jupiter fixture and unit tests, not inferred from total score after alien chains here.
